retrospective_requirement: The modified cockpit shall provide primary flight information in installed-aircraft operation.
basis: Purpose of glass-cockpit retrofit and installed-flight evidence
verification_method: Installed functional check and flight test

retrospective_requirement: The modified cockpit shall present required engine/airframe information from the revised sensor/monitoring chain.
basis: Prototype cockpit scope and EMS-related engineering exchanges
verification_method: Ground functional check and flight observation

retrospective_requirement: Retained navigation/communication equipment shall interoperate with the glass-cockpit functions required by the selected configuration.
verification_method: Interface check and installed-aircraft functional test

retrospective_requirement: The retrofit avionics shall operate from the aircraft electrical system with appropriate protection and acceptable behaviour during aircraft operation.
verification_method: Power checks, functional test and re-flight

retrospective_requirement: Replacement or changed avionics LRUs shall allow controlled restoration of software, settings and required databases.
verification_method: Configuration restore check and functional re-test

retrospective_requirement: Required retained transponder/audio/other avionics functions shall be assessed for interface compatibility with the retrofit.
The integrated retrofit configuration shall be verified on the aircraft and discrepancies shall be fed back into engineering resolution.
basis: Repeated prototype and customer-evaluation flight activity

retrospective_requirement: The selected architecture shall have a defined maintenance/spares/support concept appropriate to fleet operation.
Qualification and certification suitability shall be assessed separately from functional capability for the intended aircraft/customer context.
Candidate architectures shall be assessed for display/LRU failure response and redundancy/reversion where applicable.
basis: Garmin G900X/G950 reference architecture and G950 evaluation material
verification_method: Architecture review and applicable functional test

retrospective_requirement: Display, map, synthetic-vision, alerting and information-distribution behaviour shall be assessed in the training-aircraft operating context.
Engineering and verification evidence shall be tied to an identified prototype/configuration state.
basis: Multiple Dynon/Garmin candidates and changing hardware/software/database states
